New decision "Chose to write dispatch-ready briefs for lanes 02–05 now (docs/plans/2026-09-15-lane-briefs.md) rather than dispatching them" relates to:
- 01KQTRRN4VEXME5DNAY93Y8B8J: "Chose to convert SessionStart prompt-type hook to command-type hook for issue #8"
- 01KWX0NMA8BP7BY6R33RTRJME6: "Chose worktree-isolated named teammates (weights-34, crosspost-30, supersede-31, archive-35) sharing one Twining blackboard with distinct agent_ids"
- 01KX1RFCERGKK0PT936VW0SPC0: "Chose to amend beta enrollment instructions (Gmail draft + UPGRADE-v2.md) with a mandatory plugin step rather than relying on testers to notice the dual server"
- 01KX1W92JPGKD6AV3EVKD4SS7B: "Chose checked-in deniedMcpServers serverCommand deny over per-user /mcp disable or the ineffective disabledMcpjsonServers key"
- 01KY7347NS0VAQ67CWPJTRZND8: "Chose to scope the no-see-but-cannot-act claim to the MCP tool surface and document the dashboard/HTTP surfaces as deliberately read-only viewers"
- 01KY7347R8MDGDMA7EPHS9PXYA: "Chose code-normative openness semantics (any live entry back-reference resolves, self-references included) over the archiver doc-comment's 'any other entry' prose"
- 01M05E5HJ34HEYX1Y7RSEQESWT: "Chose a committed send-wrapper doc over an ad-hoc message"
- 01M08AXR6MH1RZZY7D81SXRN41: "Chose a 4-wave release train (data-safety first, scope-matcher change isolated in its own release) over one mega-release"
- 01M08AXR9TS3P35WBJZ1VGBJS5: "Chose to honor the challenger downgrades: ASM-disclosure treated as fully OPEN (2.7/2.9 exclusion counts are a different disclosure axis than total_in_scope/omitted) and QUAL-lifecycle-rank as PARTIAL (deboost shipped 2.9.0 but the report's two cheaper preferred remedies"
- 01M08AXRCC62X30CSTJVNN1W0S: "Chose to send the wave-2 ship memo first, unchanged except the stale line-183 fix, and answer the audit in a separate disposition doc"
- 01M0XGQH15FQYRF0RVKV417RTF: "Left the P1 neither-store-exists case and the W3 bundle split unruled"
- 01M1FDVBR16N4D2YXZKK2CTZ1M: "Chose approach A (curated ~29-page narrative site with build-time-generated tool tables) over B (39 per-tool pages) and C (slim guide)"
- 01M1FDVBX25N39YJNPP97H2EX1: "Chose to generate the site's tool reference from the server registry via the stub-server pattern (extract-tools.mjs → tools.json, CI freshness diff) rather than hand-write tables guarded by extending plugin-tool-references.test.ts"
- 01M1FDVC1RVM1STENGGGMS9CFH: "Chose to copy the 15-file research corpus into gitignored .planning/docs-site-research/ rather than committing it or leaving it in the session scratchpad"
- 01M1RB391WHBV81QGHT4KVJT5F: "Rejected a tolerant index read (DecisionStore.getIndex returning [] when decisions/index.json is absent); the fallback host gets a named STORE_UNSERVABLE error with an explicit STOP directive instead"
- 01M1RB394QDXR9WD9CK4D30W05: "Any git working-tree probe runs as `git --no-optional-locks status`, TTL-cached by projectRoot with the upstream sha in the key, invoked only from twining_status and the assemble path — never from the per-dispatch wrapper"
- 01M1RB39FZG3ZSK1WGP30X5JR1: "Amend the W2 lineage bundle before it ships: lineage_unresolved only for status superseded (or archived_from superseded) with no pointer either way; a claimant-less overridden record is a resolved veto and gets no lineage flag; overridden_by/override_reason projected wherever superseded_by is"
- 01M1VK6CRE9DY8W667NXX24J25: "CLI dispatch is extracted into src/cli/dispatch.ts (classifyArgv) so the unknown-subcommand guard is unit-testable; only a non-flag argv[2] that is not a known subcommand is refused"
